name: SURF
desc: Developmental retinal waves from calcium-imaging videos. It orients the retina dorsal-up, measures a grid of squares, detects calcium events and follows every wave: how often it comes, how fast it travels, which way it goes and how much of the retina it covers. Single-cell analysis at 40× and group statistics are built in.

name: Arborist
long: SC neuron morphology in the laminar frame
desc: Measures where a filled superior colliculus neuron sits: depth from the brain surface and position relative to the Calretinin border of the sensory SC, plus branching, Sholl analysis, the axon initial segment and cell-type classification. Tracing stays in Fiji/SNT.

name: MES Viewer
soon: Coming soon: installers for Windows and Mac
desc: Browses Femtonics .mes files: every z-stack and image with its metadata, ROI measurements, 3D views, channel subtraction against bleed-through, noise reduction with a fast preview, and TIFF export.

name: ChATlas
desc: Explores cells in CAVE / Neuroglancer EM datasets (built for stroeh_mouse_retina). Every cell is placed in ChAT-normalised depth, between the OFF (0) and ON (1) starburst bands, using surfaces fitted to the labelled starburst amacrine cells around the region you look at.

name: Mouse Colony
desc: Keeps track of breeding pairs, cages and individual mice: warns when breeders get too old, checks relatedness to avoid inbreeding, suggests pairs and predicts offspring genotypes. Cage cards can be read from photos, and the colony can be shared with colleagues through a Google Sheet.

name: Neuropixels Viewer
soon: Coming soon: installers for Windows and Mac
desc: Shows Neuropixels recordings with traces coloured by shank and ordered by depth. It prepares recordings for Kilosort, lets you curate the sorted units without Phy, drives Open Ephys remotely during recording and sends channels to Toothy.

name: SC Analysis
long: Visual responses of superior colliculus units
soon: Coming soon: installers for Windows and Mac
desc: Analyses sorted Neuropixels recordings from the superior colliculus: receptive-field maps, responses to sweeps, looms and blinks with interactive pickers, direction and speed tuning, and Baden-style functional clustering pooled across recordings.

name: HD-MEA Analysis
soon: Coming soon: installers for Windows and Mac
desc: Analyses high-density MEA recordings of the retina (BioCam .brw): stimulus triggers, spike sorting with HerdingSpikes, light responses, oscillations, receptive-field mapping and cross-correlations for gap-junction coupling.

name: FiberView
soon: Coming soon: installers for Windows and Mac
desc: Records fiber photometry from an NI DAQ or an Arduino with an ADS1115, subtracts the dark offset and computes ΔF/F with several baseline methods, with event averages aligned to visual-stimulus sync pulses.

name: OptoStim
soon: Coming soon: installers for Windows and Mac
desc: Controls an LED driver through an Arduino: steady pulse trains and frequency chirps with exact pulse widths, a small OLED display of the TTL signal, and a control window that logs every pulse edge for later alignment.

name: Optokinetic Drum
soon: Coming soon: PsychoPy experiment, Raspberry Pi recorder and calibration tools
desc: Runs the optokinetic / optomotor test in a drum of four monitors: rotating gratings from PsychoPy with settings for direction, speed and spatial frequency, an overhead Raspberry Pi camera recorder with a serial timing link to the stimulus PC, and a lens calibration that turns DeepLabCut head tracking into real distances.
